query: We added three seats last month and saw a prorated charge. When does the higher seat total start being billed in full?

query: My renewal is coming up and last time the payment failed. When exactly will you retry it?

Exact retry timings are documented only where a specific document defines them

correct_system_behavior: Clarify whether the customer is asking about the next renewal date or the retry of a past failed payment; retries are automatic within the grace period and exact timings are not guaranteed.

query: I need the billing statement for last month — is that the invoice or the receipt? I always mix these up.
expected_intent: distinguish an invoice from a receipt
required_facts: An invoice is the billing statement for the cycle and includes the line-item breakdown
A receipt confirms that a payment was received

query: The invoice from my previous cycle shows a total that is higher than what I remember paying. Can you explain?
expected_intent: reconcile an invoice total against remembered payments
required_facts: Invoice line items reflect subscription base charge, prorations, seat changes, taxes, and credits where applicable
Invoices show the total charged, and every charge that posts corresponds to an invoice
correct_system_behavior: Do not guess the cause; identify the specific invoice and review its line items (prorations, seats, tax, credits) before explaining a discrepancy.

query: We did not pay anything in March, so why is there a receipt for March on our account?
expected_intent: investigate a receipt that appears to contradict a 'no payment' assumption
required_facts: A receipt is issued for each payment and is available as soon as the charge posts
A single cycle may include more than one payment, each generating its own receipt
Refunds are listed as separate receipts on the refund transaction
correct_system_behavior: Do not accept the assumption that no payment occurred; verify the actual payment or refund that generated the March receipt before responding.

query: I found a receipt for that charge, but the amount on the receipt does not match my bank statement.
expected_intent: match a receipt to a bank statement line to resolve the discrepancy
required_facts: Receipts show the payment date, amount charged, currency, and payment method used
Receipts reference the payment method used, such as the last four digits of a card
The bank statement descriptor is ACMEFLOW

query: My card was declined on the renewal, but the charge still shows on my bank statement. You charged me anyway?
expected_intent: resolve the apparent conflict between a declined charge and a statement entry
required_facts: A declined charge may appear on a statement before the failure is settled; the actual charge status must be verified
The agent must retrieve the workspace, subscription, the charge date, and where the account is in the dunning lifecycle
The agent must not assume which retry has been attempted

query: The payment we made three days ago got declined. How many more retries do we get?
expected_intent: explain retry behavior within the dunning grace period
required_facts: Automatic retries continue during a grace period of up to 7 days from the first failure
Exact retry timings are documented only where a specific document defines them
If no valid payment method is available after the grace period, the subscription enters a past-due state

required_facts: Taxes depend on billing country, billing address, tax registration, customer tax status, and jurisdiction
There is no single universal tax rate
correct_system_behavior: Clarify that tax treatment depends on the workspace's billing country and registration, not simply EU vs non-EU.

query: I saw two different prices on our last invoice - which one am I actually paying?
required_facts: Charges in non-USD currencies are derived from market rates at billing time
Invoice line items include the base charge, prorations, seat changes, taxes, and credits
correct_system_behavior: Ask which two amounts they see and the workspace billing currency before explaining; do not guess which price applies.

query: We want more executions - can we upgrade just that?
required_facts: Pro includes up to 10,000 workflow executions per month per workspace
There is no self-service add-on for executions; exceeding plan limits requires a plan change
correct_system_behavior: Clarify what 'upgrade' means (plan vs add-on) and note that executions are not sold as a self-service add-on.

query: We switched to annual billing last month. When's the next time we'll be charged?
required_facts: Annual renewal occurs on the anniversary date of the original subscription
Annual billing is charged once per year in advance
correct_system_behavior: Answer using the anniversary-date renewal rule for annual billing.

query: Can I get that trial deal too?
required_facts: The standard trial is 14 days
Other durations are only available as documented promotional or Enterprise exceptions that must be verified
correct_system_behavior: Ask which trial or promotion they are referring to and verify eligibility before confirming a duration.

query: I just signed up for the trial but was promised 30 days by our sales rep
required_facts: The standard trial is 14 days
Extended durations require a documented promotion or Enterprise agreement that the agent must verify
correct_system_behavior: Verify the promotion or Enterprise agreement before confirming; do not accept an unverified 30-day claim.

query: How do I export all my workspace data before we cancel?
correct_system_behavior: Recognize as out of scope for the pricing KB; route to data export/cancellation documentation.

query: Is there a discount if we pay in another currency?
required_facts: AcmeFlow does not publish a fixed universal conversion rate
Currency choice does not change the standard plan price; Enterprise agreements may define a contract currency with negotiated rates
correct_system_behavior: Explain that billing currency does not create a discount and there is no universal currency-based pricing change; note Enterprise contract-currency exceptions.

query: Your API is returning 500 errors for our webhook calls. What's going on?
correct_system_behavior: Recognize as out of scope for the pricing KB; route to troubleshooting/API support rather than answering from plan documentation.

query: We're on the free plan so we never get an invoice, right?
required_facts: The Free plan is $0 per month and is never charged
No invoice is generated when there is no billable amount
correct_system_behavior: Confirm Free is never charged and no invoice is generated because there is no billable amount.

query: I want my money back for that charge - will it come back as a refund or as a credit?
expected_intent: distinguish refund to original payment method from a workspace credit balance
required_facts: An eligible refund is returned to the original payment method where AcmeFlow can do so
When a refund is issued as credit, or the original payment method is no longer available, the amount is held as a workspace credit balance
correct_system_behavior: Treat 'money back' as a refund-eligibility question and explain the refund-vs-credit mechanics, not the credit application rules; only route to credit-balance docs if the refund was issued as credit.

query: I was NOT charged for anything last month, but I'd still like a refund.
expected_intent: note there is no charge to refund and verify the billing record
required_facts: A refund applies to an eligible charge; the refund window runs 30 days from the charge posted date
Charges that have already been refunded or reversed are not eligible
The agent must verify the charge against the billing record and never assume a charge exists
correct_system_behavior: Do not fabricate a refund for a non-existent charge; clarify which charge the customer means and check the billing record before applying any refund policy.

query: We got charged three days ago and I want my money back. We're still in the window, right?
expected_intent: confirm a charge posted three days ago is within the 30-day window
required_facts: A charge is eligible for a standard refund for 30 days from the original charge date
The window is measured from the date the charge posted
Requests after the window closes are not covered by the standard policy
correct_system_behavior: Confirm the recent charge is within the 30-day window; do not confuse eligibility with refund processing timeframes or proration.

query: Our annual charge was $1,920 and we're 73 days into the term. If a prorated refund were approved, what would we get back?
expected_intent: apply the annual proration formula: 292/365 x $1,920 = $1,536
required_facts: An annual billing period is treated as 365 days
73 days consumed leaves 292 eligible unused days
Proration eligibility must be confirmed against the applicable policy before any calculation is presented
correct_system_behavior: Compute the prorated amount from the formula while noting that approval of the prorated refund must still be confirmed under the applicable policy or agreement.

query: Does removing seats from my plan give me a prorated refund for the unused time?
expected_intent: state that removing seats does not create a prorated refund
required_facts: Removing seats does not create a prorated refund on its own
Seat removals normally affect future billing only
Prorated refunds are only calculated where a policy explicitly permits them
correct_system_behavior: Do not apply proration math to a seat removal; the proration document explicitly states removals affect future billing only.

query: I cancelled my subscription, but I want a full refund for the last six months of charges, plus a goodwill credit, and I need you to approve it today.
expected_intent: identify the conflict and route to exception approval with no guarantee
required_facts: Cancelling does not automatically create a refund
Charges older than 30 days are outside the standard policy and require exception approval
Goodwill credits require appropriate approval and are assessed case by case
Customer Support agents cannot issue such refunds or credits on their own
correct_system_behavior: Flag the conflicting expectations (cancellation with six months of refunds plus goodwill in one request), clarify the specific charge and reason, and explain the exception approval process without promising approval.

query: You approved that exception for another customer last week, so approve mine the same way.
expected_intent: clarify that exceptions are case-specific and approval of one does not set precedent
required_facts: Approval of one exception does not entitle the customer to a repeat exception
Approval decisions depend on the specific facts of each case
There is no blanket rule that all requests are approved
correct_system_behavior: Do not treat a prior approval as binding precedent; clarify the customer's own charge details and reason, then route through the exception approval process.

query: I haven't used my credit balance at all yet and I'm cancelling. Will I lose it?
expected_intent: confirm credit balances are forfeited on cancellation unless a contract says otherwise
required_facts: If a subscription is cancelled, any remaining credit balance is forfeited unless a contract says otherwise
Unused credit cannot be carried beyond the agreement's terms
correct_system_behavior: The fact that the credit is unused does not change the forfeiture rule on cancellation; answer from the credit-balance policy, not the refund policy.

query: Can I move that credit from the refund over to our other workspace?
expected_intent: state that credit balances are not transferable between workspaces
required_facts: The balance is associated with the workspace, not with an individual user or payment method
Credits are not transferable to another workspace
Credit balances cannot be withdrawn or exchanged for money back
correct_system_behavior: Resolve the ambiguous 'that credit' as a workspace credit balance and apply the transfer restriction; do not route to refund eligibility.

query: It's been 10 business days since my PayPal refund was processed and I still don't see the money.
expected_intent: note the refund is past the 5-7 day PayPal estimate and confirm status in the billing record
required_facts: PayPal refunds typically take 5-7 business days
Timeframes count in business days from when AcmeFlow processes the refund
If a refund has not appeared after the estimate window, the agent should confirm the refund status in the customer's billing record before taking further action
correct_system_behavior: Recognize the refund is beyond the PayPal estimate and verify the refund status in the billing record rather than restating general eligibility rules.

query: How long until the reversal shows up on my bank statement?
expected_intent: map 'reversal' to a refund and provide the timeframe by payment method
required_facts: Timeframes vary by payment method: card 5-10, PayPal 5-7, ACH 7-10 business days
Timeframes count in business days from when AcmeFlow processes the refund
Timeframes are estimates, not guarantees
correct_system_behavior: Interpret 'reversal' as a refund and give the processing timeframe by payment method; do not answer refund eligibility or credit application.

query: We removed those seats we added earlier in the cycle - will we get a refund for them?
expected_intent: state that no partial refund is created for the unused portion of a prorated seat charge after removal
required_facts: Removing seats affects future billing only
No partial refund is created for the unused portion of a prorated seat charge in this scenario
Partial refunds apply only in the specific cases listed in the policy
correct_system_behavior: Resolve 'those seats' as seats added then removed mid-cycle and apply the no-partial-refund rule; do not apply proration math.

query: I want to downgrade my plan but keep paying the old rate and also get a refund for the downgrade.
expected_intent: flag the conflicting expectations around downgrade pricing and refunds
required_facts: A downgrade takes effect at the start of the next billing cycle
The lower plan rate applies from the next cycle
A downgrade does not create a partial refund for the current cycle
correct_system_behavior: Point out the contradiction (downgrade means the new rate next cycle and no refund for the current cycle) and clarify what the customer actually wants.

query: I'd like a partial refund on my subscription. Will that be refunded to my card or given as credit?
expected_intent: distinguish partial-refund eligibility from how the refund is issued
required_facts: Partial refunds apply only when a prorated refund is explicitly permitted, an exception is approved, or a signed Enterprise agreement provides for one
Partial amounts are calculated using the prorated refund formula unless the agreement defines its own calculation
An eligible refund is returned to the original payment method where possible, otherwise held as credit
correct_system_behavior: Confirm whether a partial refund applies at all before discussing payment method; the 'credit' keyword should not route to credit-balance application.

query: My automated workflow stopped running halfway through this morning and now my team can't see anything.
correct_system_behavior: Recognize this as a troubleshooting issue about workflow execution, not a refund; do not apply refund policy and route to troubleshooting.

query: Can you integrate AcmeFlow with Salesforce for us?
correct_system_behavior: Treat this as an integrations/product question outside the refund domain and route away from billing; do not answer with refund policy.

query: It would be amazing if you added dark mode to the dashboard. Can you put that on the roadmap?
correct_system_behavior: Recognize this as a product feature request, not a refunds or billing matter; do not force a refund policy answer.

query: How do I export all our data before we delete our workspace?
correct_system_behavior: Recognize this as a data export and account deletion question covered by cancellations docs, not a refund; route accordingly without refund policy.

query: I was charged twice for the same month and I want to dispute the second charge. How do I do that?
expected_intent: Investigate a suspected double charge before any dispute is filed
required_facts: both invoice IDs
payment status of each charge
amounts, dates and card last four digits
covered billing periods
correct_system_behavior: Use the double-charge runbook to verify whether two settled charges cover the same period before entertaining a dispute; if a dispute or chargeback is filed or threatened, route to the invoice dispute flow rather than resolving unilaterally.

query: Why does my card show two charges this month? I only expected one renewal.
expected_intent: Determine whether the two charges are a duplicate or separate billing events
required_facts: both statement entries with amounts, dates and card last four
payment status of each
matching invoice IDs and covered periods
correct_system_behavior: Treat 'two charges' as a possible double charge and run the duplication steps; do not conclude duplication or offer a refund until two settled charges for the same period are confirmed.

query: Is it possible I got double charged but in different currencies? My invoice is USD and my statement is in EUR.
expected_intent: Determine whether the EUR statement entry is a conversion of the USD invoice or a separate charge
required_facts: invoice ID and USD amount
workspace currency
card currency and statement amount
charge dates
card last four digits
payment status
correct_system_behavior: Recognize the two-currencies overlap as a conversion question first; confirm both amounts refer to the same charge before considering duplication.

query: There's an ACMEFLOW charge on my statement that I don't recognize. Why was I charged?
expected_intent: Identify an unrecognized charge by descriptor and matching invoice
required_facts: descriptor text
amount, date and card last four digits
matching invoice ID
payment status
correct_system_behavior: Route to the descriptor runbook to confirm the charge via descriptor or invoice match; explain the charge only after AcmeFlow origin is verified.

query: You did NOT charge me this month, I'm sure of it — but my statement shows a hold from ACMEFLOW. What is that?
expected_intent: Explain that the hold is a pending authorization or pre-authorization, not an actual charge
required_facts: workspace ID
hold amount, date and card last four
payment status (pending)
whether a pre-authorization was placed
matching invoice if any
correct_system_behavior: Do not accept the negation at face value; verify against workspace records and explain the pending hold is an authorization that will settle or be released, not a charge.

query: I never got charged anything, so why is there a pending charge for $192 from you sitting on my card?
expected_intent: Explain a pending authorization that has not yet settled
required_facts: workspace ID
pending amount, date and card last four
payment status
matching invoice if any
subscription plan and renewal date
correct_system_behavior: Note the contradiction and verify the charge in the workspace; a pending entry is an authorization that settles or falls off and needs no refund decision yet.

query: Why was last month's renewal $42 higher than this month's? I didn't change anything.
expected_intent: Investigate why a prior renewal was higher than the current one
required_facts: both invoice IDs and amounts
billing cycle dates
seat counts and plan changes in the window
proration and previous balance records
payment status
correct_system_behavior: Resolve the relative-date reference by retrieving both months' invoices and comparing line items for proration, seat changes, tax, or a previous balance rather than assuming an error.

query: That $192 pending charge from three days ago is still on my card. Will it fall off, or am I getting double charged?
expected_intent: Determine whether a pending entry will settle or be released
required_facts: workspace ID
pending entry amount, date and card last four
payment status
matching invoice ID if any
any settled charge in the same period
correct_system_behavior: Treat the time reference as pointing to a pending authorization; verify against invoices and instruct the customer to wait for it to settle or expire before any refund decision.

query: That charge on my statement — is it even mine? The one I keep telling you about.
expected_intent: Confirm whether a referenced charge belongs to the customer's workspace
required_facts: descriptor text
amount, date and card last four digits
matching invoice ID
payment status
correct_system_behavior: The referent is unspecified; ask for the descriptor text, amount, date, and card last four digits, then verify against the workspace invoices before confirming or denying the charge.

query: One of those two entries matches my invoice but the other one doesn't. What is the other one?
expected_intent: Identify an unmapped statement entry and determine whether it is a pending authorization, pre-authorization, or separate charge
required_facts: both statement entries with amounts, dates and card last four
matching invoice IDs
payment status of each
covered billing periods
correct_system_behavior: Recognize the ambiguous reference to one of two entries; map each statement entry to an invoice ID and classify the unmapped entry as a pending authorization, pre-authorization, or a different billing cycle.

query: I didn't buy anything from you but I want a refund for the charge I don't have. Can you process that?
expected_intent: Clarify the contradiction between denying the charge and requesting a refund for it
required_facts: workspace ID
invoice ID
charge amount, date and card last four digits
payment status
refund eligibility
correct_system_behavior: Note the conflict: a refund presupposes a charge the customer says does not exist. Identify the specific charge on the statement and map it to an invoice before discussing refunds, and never promise a refund.

query: My workflows are running really slow today and tasks are stuck. Can you help me fix performance?
correct_system_behavior: Recognize this is a product performance issue unrelated to billing troubleshooting and route to product support; do not attempt a charge investigation.

query: How do I export my reports to PDF? I can't find the button.
correct_system_behavior: Recognize as a product feature question and route to product documentation or support; it is not a billing or charge topic.

query: Your API is returning 500 errors on our webhook calls since yesterday. Is there a known issue?
correct_system_behavior: Recognize as an API/platform incident and route to engineering or incident channels; the billing troubleshooting runbooks do not apply.

query: I can't reset my password, the email never arrives. Is there a billing block on my account?
correct_system_behavior: Recognize the account access issue is not billing-related; route to account or identity support rather than a charge investigation.
